provenance_statement: Synthetic benchmark dataset generated for architectural pipeline demonstration. Evaluation demonstrates pipeline mechanics and statistical separation, not empirical real-world validation.
target_observation_window: Settled snapshot engagement after at least 7 days since publication. Filtered out immature posts under 7 days of observation.

instagram.note: Insufficient held-out evaluation samples for platform 'instagram' (test N=0 < 3); platform-specific error metrics omitted rather than training an unreliable small-sample model.

youtube.note: Evaluated on N=23 held-out 'youtube' posts from the chronological test split.

methodological_limitations.selection_optimism_risk: Model selection (choosing Ridge over tree ensembles) was conducted on the same held-out test split. For streaming real-world data, rolling-origin cross-validation (walk-forward evaluation) is recommended.
methodological_limitations.prediction_interval_validity: Reported intervals represent approximate empirical residual dispersion bands (+/- q95 or +/- 1.96*RMSE). They are not guaranteed conformal prediction intervals with formal finite-sample coverage guarantees.
methodological_limitations.sample_size: N=112 mature posts. Indicative prototype only.
